name: HoneyBook
summary: Client management platform for independent businesses.

flows.title: Create a project
steps: From your homepage, select + New in the top-right corner > Project.
Enter the project's details. The project name and date are required; you can skip the other fields and update them later.
Add a participant to the project, either by selecting an existing one or by creating a new one and entering the client's details, then select Add.

flows.title: Import leads and clients from a spreadsheet into your pipeline
steps: Prepare a CSV, XLS or XLSX file of at most 500 leads or clients. One project is created for each contact imported, and this works on the web only.
From the navigation menu, select Projects, then the dropdown by Create new > Import spreadsheet.
Drag and drop your file, or select Browse files to upload it. Review the list of projects and contacts and uncheck any you want to exclude; if the file has several sheets, select which to import.

Select Manage fields to map your file's columns to HoneyBook fields. Unmatched fields are not imported, and Do not import skips a column. If the file has no column headers, uncheck My file has headers and label each column with the dropdowns.
Select Preview, then Import. The leads and clients are added to your pipeline and your Contacts page.
